summary: Introduces check mode (simulate without changing remote systems, with supporting modules reporting would-be changes and others doing nothing) and diff mode (before-and-after comparisons), which can be combined to validate playbooks.
questions: How can I see what a playbook would do without changing anything?
What's the difference between check mode and diff mode?
What happens to modules that don't support check mode?
Can I use check and diff mode together?

answer_card.title: Check mode and diff mode
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Check mode**: Ansible runs without making changes on remote systems. Modules that support it report the changes they would have made; modules that don't support it report nothing and do nothing.
- **Diff mode**: Ansible shows before-and-after comparisons; supporting modules display details.

Use them separately or together for detailed validation of a playbook or role.
